fusions.name: Gentle Grip
fusions.desc: A grasping strike with your nails that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Firm Hold
fusions.desc: Seizes one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 9 damage, stunning it for 1 second and taking its next action away for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Laid-On Palm
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Mender's Ring
fusions.desc: Conjures a smooth ring: your maximum health rises by 10, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 4 health.
